description: Executable foundation segment consumed by verify_internal. One Null invocation request enters a linear, read-only chain for safe project loading, governance baseline, declared contracts, and project contracts. The caller constructs one immutable typed invocation resource for root, mode, and reset state; those control fields are not JSON payload fields. Each node returns a runtime error to the same invocation failure boundary and stops later nodes. The unmigrated remainder consumes only the final project_checked.project value. It does not require summary freezing, hash manifests, identity wrapping, or a generic control plane.

nodes.description: Reads and parses project JSON with the existing project-file safety checks, without adding an early project schema. Any legal JSON project value is wrapped as {project: value}. The caller checks root safety and reads reset state once before constructing the immutable typed invocation resource.
Validates governance map structure and required fields. Daily migration identity replay is excluded; this node does not calculate or compare hashes, snapshots, or candidate identity wrappers.
Runs the current assert_declared_contracts validation for canonical declarations, zones, and record semantics. The project payload is retained for the next node.

Runs the current assert_project_contract validation for project, module, governance-root, ownership, build, and applicable regression contracts. The final Object is the single graph output for the unmigrated remainder of verify_internal.
